title: CRM FASHION RADAR

rules.source: New fashion promotional / CRM messages actually received in the connected Gmail mailbox; monitored brand names alone do not prove the address is subscribed.
rules.brand_matching: Resolve and verify actual From sender names/domains from received messages before classifying; never assume brand domain from display name alone.
rules.inclusion: Include a message only when it has a recipient-accessible original browser/web-version URL or a verified safe, viewable letter copy. Never use a private Gmail link as a report source.
rules.no_available_source: Exclude the message from the shared issue, rather than publishing an inaccessible summary.
rules.subject_preheader: Keep original language and exact wording; analysis in Russian.
rules.hypotheses: Describe idea and why it is interesting; link to the exact source newsletter; no test-method tutorials.
rules.publication: Editorial draft for user approval first; never auto-publish or send.

current_operation: Editorial configuration only. Google Apps Script Gmail read-only test succeeds, but standalone GitHub Actions Gmail ingestion and automatic weekly drafting are not yet deployed.
